title: Units regulators and hR validation
objective: Implement unit-lattice extraction/saturation interfaces, rigorous regulator enclosures, rigorous zeta log-residue bounds, and hR index validation with focused tests

handoff.summary: Added an ordinary strict-Python analytic proof layer for class/unit computations. Exact relation dependencies replay as integral left kernels with maximal-minor saturation indices and certificate-driven p-saturation states. Exact rational endpoint balls plus mpmath.libmp directed rounding certify weighted-log regulator determinants with precision escalation. A provider-oriented Belabas--Friedman implementation authenticates every splitting type below its theorem-selected cutoff, encloses the finite prime-power sum and complete analytic tail separately, and feeds a rigorous analytic class-number-formula comparison that returns an integer interval for the missing hR index. Focused Sage/PARI fixtures cover real/imaginary quadratic and rank-two cubic data; direct CPython and generated Sage.js witnesses agree.
risks: Rigorous zeta status assumes the caller supplies the actual maximal-order discriminant and a complete exact splitting provider; the function validates prime coverage and every local degree identity but does not independently prove the field/order identity.

Unit p-saturation is a verification interface: only evidence objects whose verify method succeeds become rigorous. This lane does not implement the algebraic p-th-root obstruction producer, so an unchecked search result remains explicitly unverified.

The common base had no public RealBall enclosure transport. This module therefore uses exact rational endpoints and mpmath.libmp directed-rounding intervals; future Arb transport can supply the same lower/upper protocol without changing proof states.

The arithmetic-algebra lane policy requires pnpm test:native before review. Per coordinator direction, this handoff stays active with focused receipts; central integration owns that broad native gate.
next_steps: Integration should add class_unit_analytic.py to pyrightconfig.json and the focused test to the node test manifest, then expose the selected public APIs.
